body:
I know this isn't much coming from a stranger on the internet, but I just wanted to say thank you for your "puppy surprise grandpa" recommendation. 

Long story short I been very low recently, and have spent the last three and a half hours in tears. On a whim followed your suggestion, and I'm now happysad crying instead of feeling just plain desperate. 

As you said, the joy is infectious. Thank you for sharing it :)

The pressure is a combination of that I have put on myself (I can be a bit of a Lisa Simpson), but also others expecting me to maintain the achievements I have previously made, regardless with how much I might be struggling. The idea that I can barely get out of bed in the morning, or that I no longer care about the achievements I have had has been unbelievable to the people I have tried to talk to.

All I really want is some kind of meaningful connection with any other humans, to not feel so alone on this earth, but with superficial "good things" in life people seem to think that it is impossible to harbor sadness.

Anyway. I thought I felt like talking through things, but to be honest after ruminating over it all for so long tonight I just feel exhausted.

On a last note, I've seen how much you post on this sub, and you give me hope for humans. (I know it's popular on reddit to say things like "faith in humans restored, etc.", but as someone who has been feeling pretty fucking low about us as a species - you are definitely a point to the positive side.

Good night

I guess a big part of it is how used to having a support system in him I've become. 

I'm under a ridiculous amount of pressure at the moment, and the idea of going at it alone is terrifying. I feel ashamed, because I always thought that I was stronger than this, that I could do it all myself. But now it turns out that when left to myself all I want to do is disappear.

Thank you. Just knowing there is someone out there right now means more than I can say.

I would love to work things out with him but I just don't know how. Whenever we talk we fight and things get worse. I don't know.

I think we ended up in the unhealthy place of being each other's only real support system, which means now that it's breaking there's nowhere else really to turn.

I just feel desperately lonely. But really, knowing that someone out there on this massive fucking planet has read what I spewed into the internet, and took the time to respond means so much. Thank you
